answer_1.quote: PASS (Personalized Automated Soccer texts System) is a modular data-to-text system that produces Dutch summaries of football matches...

answer_4.quote: Evaluators were first asked to identify the stance of each text... Then the quality of the texts was evaluated according to two main criteria, namely Fluency and Clarity, each of which was assessed via (dis)agreement with two statements... on a 7‑point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Identify stance; rate Fluency via statements S1 and S2; rate Clarity via statements S3 and S4 on a 7‑point Likert scale.
